setup.structure: x=LP[e]; u=kp*Lead[x]+kp*Lead[Vi[HIGS_i[x]]] i.e. C*=kp*Clp*Lead*(1+wi/s) as in ControllerAlgorithm/make_design; HIGS kh=1, wc=wh*sqrt(1+16/pi^2); bilinear digital blocks
setup.loop: L = kp*C_DF(z=exp(jwTs)) * G8 * exp(-j w Ts*extra); G8 = measured_response() (16 kHz hold -> 8 kHz hold)
setup.scenarios: nominal_delay1: extra = 1 sample computational delay (requested). stress_delay6: extra = 6 samples, the delay stress of the repo's measured_linear_metrics (old_gate_* fields give the repo's full gate)
setup.td_gate: screened designs (this script's addition): no divergence, no clipping at 0.08 A, last-0.2 s error RMS <= 50.0 urad (round trip and load step) and, for HIGS modes, max|S| <= 2 with the numeric DF of the whole cascade

time_domain_setup.plant: identified 4-state two-inertia model, exact ZOH at 8 kHz, 2-sample delay, current clamp 0.08 A, no quantization, no feedforward (ffValue = 0 as in higs_host.cpp)
time_domain_setup.reference: higs_two_inertia.reference_profile(): 0.1 rad round trip, 0.1 s min-jerk moves, 0.2 s dwell
time_domain_setup.settle_window: 0.2 s after the end of each move (0.5-0.7 s and 0.8-1.0 s)
time_domain_setup.disturbance: 0.005 (Kt=1 current units) step on the load inertia at t=0.1 s, 1.6 s record, r=0; IAE of load-angle error
